description: Curated R_COMP-SIG subset: 10 long rule sentences (one per template T1-T9 + one extra with non-pool labels), each with its 10 few-shot LLM translations (100 candidate rows) carrying z3 labels, consensus scores and LLM-judge scores. Sentences picked for having both ERROR and CORRECT translations, so the subset is error-enriched relative to the full 221-sentence set.

sentences.text: Each graduate student who is criticized by their boss, who can use the left foot very efficiently, and who lives in cramped residential buildings is an employee in James's town, except if the graduate student has a temporary role at the orchestra.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (GraduateStudent(x) ∧ CriticizedBy(x, boss) ∧ UseEfficiently(x, leftFoot) ∧ LiveIn(x, crampedBuilding) ∧ ¬HaveTemporaryRoleAt(x, theOrchestra) → EmployeeIn(x, jamesSTown))
sentences.reference_fol_strong: ∀x (GraduateStudent(x) ∧ CriticizedBy(x, boss) ∧ UseEfficiently(x, leftFoot) ∧ LiveIn(x, crampedBuilding) → (EmployeeIn(x, jamesSTown) ↔ ¬HaveTemporaryRoleAt(x, theOrchestra)))

sentences.text: If a racehorse does not need a large territory and is a warm-blooded vertebrate, and the racehorse also can fly, then the racehorse eats a lot, except when the racehorse is in a race.

Every American Airlines aircraft that is food and that makes tea has been adapted from its original version, providing that the American Airlines aircraft is displayed on the homepage and has a high carbohydrate content.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (AmericanAirlinesAircraft(x) ∧ Food(x) ∧ MakeTea(x) ∧ DisplayedIn(x, homepage) ∧ HighCarbohydrateContent(x) → AdaptedFromOriginal(x))

sentences.text: A book that uses a rigorous methodology and that is read by Tomas contains a collection as long as the book is disposable, unless the book makes tea.
Each project that loses its leaves in autumn and that flows to the Bronx belongs to the company, provided that the project is not extractive, except if the project has a wooden body.

Except if the telescope transmits voice and data, each telescope that is designed to observe distant objects and that has sufficient mass for its self-gravity is reusable, provided that the telescope is convenient.
Anyone who comes to work every day with a positive attitude, can pack and move out of their room very easily, and lives in North America is uncomfortable unless they are female.

When a camera does not orbit around a star, is designed by Apple, and produces sound through the vibration of stretched strings, the camera has a spherical shape, but only if the camera has skis on the front.
No singer who is found guilty, who presents their work at the conference, and who works full-time reasons, unless the singer is a member of the university faculty.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (Singer(x) ∧ FoundGuilty(x) ∧ PresentWorkAt(x, conference) ∧ Work(x, fullTime) ∧ ¬MemberOf(x, universityFaculty) → ¬Reason(x))
sentences.reference_fol_strong: ∀x (Singer(x) ∧ FoundGuilty(x) ∧ PresentWorkAt(x, conference) ∧ Work(x, fullTime) → (¬Reason(x) ↔ ¬MemberOf(x, universityFaculty)))

sentences.text: A wetland that is not by Phoenix and that receives voice and data follows the scientific method as long as the wetland orbits a star, unless the wetland boils water.
